name: VeylornStudios
description: Cinematic home for professionally crafted AI medieval fantasy films.
descriptionMore: VeylornStudios' YouTube channel describes itself as a cinematic home for professionally crafted AI medieval fantasy films — ancient kingdoms, knights, forbidden magic, monsters. Its catalog so far is THE LOST KIND trilogy (Son of Monsters, Sins of Men, Heart of the Lost), credited on-screen as "Created by VEYLORN" and made using AI-assisted filmmaking techniques.
